spec_evidence.checked: Cached stripe OAS snapshots (openapi/spec3.json): the terminal_configuration_configuration_resource_tipping schema lists 22 currency blocks including bgn in v2153 and 21 in v2154 with only bgn removed (token count for "bgn" 4 -> 0 across the whole spec). Both terminal configuration request schemas declare additionalProperties:false, so sending tipping[bgn] is rejected after the change. The eur block is retained in both versions. Fourteen records are per-surface projections of one schema removal (create/update/get/list x request/response x bgn subtree).

alternative_data_source: Bulgaria adopted the euro; the eur tipping block remains available in both spec versions for the same accounts.

fix.migration_guide: Terminal configuration tipping no longer supports the bgn currency block (tipping.bgn.percentages). Remove bgn from tipping payloads sent to POST /v1/terminal/configurations and delete reads of the bgn block from configuration responses. If Bulgarian terminals still need tipping presets, configure the eur block instead (amount conversion from lev to euro is a business decision at the fixed BGN/EUR rate).
fix.example_before:
const cfg = await stripe.terminal.configurations.retrieve(id);
const presets = cfg.tipping.bgn.percentages;
fix.example_after:
const cfg = await stripe.terminal.configurations.retrieve(id);
const presets = cfg.tipping.eur?.percentages ?? [];
